sources.location: first 300 KB of each of the 40 .raw files under https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2022/02/PXD009428/ (acquisition method path 'Glioblastomaeksosomer fra Kamilla'; Q Exactive)

claims.evidence: All 40 RAW files in the PRIDE file list each claimed once (32 in-gel = 8 sample sets x 4 gel fractions; 8 in-solution).
PRIDE organism; Swiss-Prot human search; GBM cells T1018 are human. Blanks: not applicable.
Exosomes from patient-derived primary glioblastoma multiforme cells (T1018). Blank isolates: not applicable.
Supp Table S.1: T1018 = Brain, GBM, primary. Sample actually analysed is exosomes in culture medium of cells derived from a brain biopsy.

Blanks (Gb, Sb, GB, SB) are the isolation blanks described in the paper (blank isolates for each isolation method). Mapping of file-name codes to blanks is inferred from the 'b'/'B' suffix; not stated in the deposit.

File-name prefixes G and S each have exactly one blank and three replicates in both in-gel and in-solution sets; interpreted as the two isolation methods (UC vs kit) but which is which is NOT stated anywhere retrievable, so it is not annotated.
PRIDE: three isolate replicates for each of in-gel and in-solution. Numbering follows file-name order (G18,G18T,R18 -> 1,2,3; S1-1..S3-1; G1..G3; S1..S3); inferred.
Gel cut in four fractions (0-25, 25-70, 70-130, 130-up kDa); fraction ids follow that order. In-solution files unfractionated (not applicable).
PRIDE instrument; Supp S-8: Q Exactive in both laboratories; RAW headers 'Method of Q Exactive'.
Protocol: DTT reduction, IAM alkylation for both in-gel and in-solution.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl (C) fixed; Oxidation (M), Acetyl any N-term variable
claims.evidence: Both msf files: StaticModification Carbamidomethyl C; Dynamic Oxidation M and Acetyl any N-terminus. Protocol text also lists deamidation (N/Q), which is absent from the msf parameters, so omitted.

claims.location: comment[precursor mass tolerance] / comment[fragment mass tolerance]
claims.evidence: Protocol and msf PeptideTolerance 10 ppm, FragmentTolerance 0.1 Da.
Supp S-8: data-dependent positive mode, Top8/Top10 method names in RAW headers.
Not stated explicitly; Q Exactive HCD assumed (Supp S-8.1 gives normalized collision energy 28 for lab 1).

limitations: Which file-name group (G or S) is ultracentrifugation vs Total Exosome Isolation kit is not stated in the deposit or retrievable paper/supplement; isolation method is therefore not annotated and the factor value is only sample type (study sample vs negative control).
Source names, replicate numbering and blank assignment are inferred from file names.
Whether in-gel and in-solution replicates derive from the same three isolates is not stated; treated as separate sources.
Patient age, sex, individual id not reported (not available).
Deamidation listed in the protocol is not present in the deposited msf parameters (two msf files read); not annotated.
Dissociation HCD and the in-solution (laboratory 2) instrument identity are assumptions from the paper; RAW header of in-solution files shows a truncated instrument string.

Breast cancer (MDA-MB-231) exosomes are described in the paper but no deposited RAW file names or paths refer to them; all 40 RAW files treated as GBM (in-gel RAW headers reference 'Glioblastomaeksosomer').
The PRIDE organismPart field (cell suspension culture) was not used.
Full-network parse_sdrf validation passed; the cache-only run only complained that 'study sample' is missing from the local OLS cache.
